title: Railway RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Result with Score Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk: 2424; Accounts Clerk Cum Typist: 394; Junior Clerk Cum Typist: 163; Trains Clerk: 77
qualification: 10+2 Intermediate passed from a recognized board in India
ageLimit: 18 to 30 years as on 01/01/2025; age relaxation as per RRB rules
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 500; SC / ST / Female / PH: Rs. 250. Refund rules apply after appearing in CBT I.
selectionProcess: CBT I -> CBT II -> Typing Skill Test (where applicable) -> Document Verification -> Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Registration credentials, admit card, score card and valid photo ID
howToApply:
1. Open the RRB NTPC result or score card link
2. Select the applicable RRB zone
3. Enter registration number and date of birth or password
4. Download and print the result or score card
5. For CBT II, also download the exam city slip and admit card when available
shortDescription: RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate CEN 07/2025 CBT I result and score card 2026. Check the 3,050-post result, regional cut-offs and CBT II exam city details.
content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level CBT I Result 2026 for CEN 07/2025. The recruitment covers 3,050 posts and shortlisted candidates can check their score card and CBT II details.

Important updates

  • CBT I result: 24 August 2026
  • CBT I score card: 26 August 2026
  • CBT II exam city: 07 September 2026
  • CBT II exam date: 17 September 2026

Post-wise vacancy

  • Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk: 2,424
  • Accounts Clerk Cum Typist: 394
  • Junior Clerk Cum Typist: 163
  • Trains Clerk: 77

Use the official RRB portal to download the result, score card, exam city slip or admit card. Regional result and cut-off PDFs are listed below where available.

importantDates.examDate: CBT I: 07-09 May, 13-15 and 16-20 Jun 2026; CBT II: 17 Sep 2026
importantDates.admitCardDate: CBT II exam city: 07 Sep 2026; admit card 4 days before exam
